short: The peace that stripped Sweden of its Baltic provinces and made Russia an empire.
full:
Signed at Nystad in Finland on 10 September 1721, the treaty ended the Great Northern War between Sweden and Russia. Sweden ceded Estonia, Livonia, Ingria, the town of Vyborg and part of Karelia in perpetuity. Finland was returned, and Russia paid two million riksdaler for the ceded territory, a face-saving formula that also protected Swedish access to Livonian grain.

Sweden had already surrendered Bremen-Verden to Hanover and most of its Pomeranian holdings to Prussia in the settlements of 1719 and 1720. What remained was Sweden proper, Finland and a strip of Pomerania around Stralsund. Peter I took the title of Emperor of All Russia seven weeks after the signing. At home the peace confirmed the constitutional changes of 1719 and 1720: the Riksdag governed, the crown did not, and Sweden gave up great-power politics for the rest of the century. Sabaton's "Ruina Imperii" is about that collapse, and closes the album on it.
